text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Direct Aaron and his sons to deal carefully with the sacred donations of the people of Israel, which they dedicate to me, so that they may not profane my holy name; I am the Lord .
text_cn: “你告诉亚郎和他的儿子，叫他们对以色列子民献与我的圣物应谨慎，免得亵渎了我的圣名：我是上主。

text_en: Say to them: If anyone among all your offspring throughout your generations comes near the sacred donations, which the people of Israel dedicate to the Lord , while he is in a state of uncleanness, that person shall be cut off from my presence: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 你对他们说：世世代代，你们后裔中，若有玷污不洁的，竟敢接近以色列子民献与上主的圣物，这人应由我面前铲除：我是上主。

text_en: No one of Aaron’s offspring who has a leprous disease or suffers a discharge may eat of the sacred donations until he is clean. Whoever touches anything made unclean by a corpse or a man who has had an emission of semen,
text_cn: 亚郎的后裔中，凡患癞病或淋病的，在他未取洁以前，不可吃圣物；凡摸过死尸所染不洁之物的，或遗精的人，

text_en: and whoever touches any swarming thing by which he may be made unclean or any human being by whom he may be made unclean—whatever his uncleanness may be—
text_cn: 或摸了任何能染上不洁的爬虫，或摸了能使自己染上任何不洁的人；

text_en: the person who touches any such shall be unclean until evening and shall not eat of the sacred donations unless he has washed his body in water.
text_cn: 凡摸了这些东西的人，直到晚上是不洁的，除非他用水洗身，不准吃圣物。

text_en: When the sun sets he shall be clean; and afterward he may eat of the sacred donations, for they are his food.
text_cn: 太阳一落，他就洁净了，以后可吃圣物，因为这是属他的食物。

text_en: That which died or was torn by wild animals he shall not eat, becoming unclean by it: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 不可吃自死或被猛兽撕裂的兽肉，免得染上不洁：我是上主。

text_en: They shall keep my charge, so that they may not incur guilt and die in the sanctuary for having profaned it: I am the Lord ; I sanctify them.
text_cn: 他们应遵守我的训令，免陷于罪恶；因此亵渎训令的，必遭死亡：我是使他们成圣的上主。

text_en: No lay person shall eat of the sacred donations. No bound or hired servant of the priest shall eat of the sacred donations;
text_cn: 任何族外人，不准吃圣物；司祭的客人和佣工，也不准吃圣物；

text_en: but if a priest acquires anyone by purchase, the person may eat of them; and those that are born in his house may eat of his food.
text_cn: 但是司祭用银钱买来的仆人，却可以吃；凡生在他家的人，也可以吃这食物。

text_en: If a priest’s daughter marries a layman, she shall not eat of the offering of the sacred donations;
text_cn: 司祭的女儿，如嫁给族外人为妻，不准吃作献仪的圣物；

text_en: but if a priest’s daughter is widowed or divorced, without offspring, and returns to her father’s house, as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s food. No lay person shall eat of it.
text_cn: 但是司祭的女儿，如成了寡妇或弃妇，因没有儿子，又回到父家，如同她年轻时一样，可以吃她父亲的食物；但是任何族外人不得吃。

text_en: If a man eats of the sacred donation unintentionally, he shall add one-fifth of its value to it, and give the sacred donation to the priest.
text_cn: 如果一人因不慎而吃了圣物，应偿还所吃的圣物，还应另加五分之一，交与司祭。

text_en: No one shall profane the sacred donations of the people of Israel, which they offer to the Lord ,
text_cn: 司祭不应让以色列子民亵渎所献与上主的圣物，

text_en: causing them to bear guilt requiring a guilt offering, by eating their sacred donations: for I am the Lord ; I sanctify them.
text_cn: 而使他们因吃自己献的圣物，负起赔偿的罪债；因为我是使他们成圣的上主。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to Aaron and his sons and all the people of Israel and say to them: When anyone of the house of Israel or of the aliens residing in Israel presents an offering, whether in payment of a vow or as a freewill offering that is offered to the Lord as a burnt offering,
text_cn: “你告诉亚郎和他的儿子，以及全体以色列子民说：以色列家中或住在以色列中的外方人，任何人如奉献祭品，不管是为还愿，或出于自愿，献给上主作全燔祭的，

text_en: to be acceptable in your behalf it shall be a male without blemish, of the cattle or the sheep or the goats.
text_cn: 应是一只无瑕的公牛，公绵羊，或公山羊，方蒙悦纳。

text_en: You shall not offer anything that has a blemish, for it will not be acceptable in your behalf.
text_cn: 凡身上有残疾的，你们不应奉献，因为这样为你们决不会获得悦纳。

text_en: When anyone offers a sacrifice of well-being to the Lord , in fulfillment of a vow or as a freewill offering, from the herd or from the flock, to be acceptable it must be perfect; there shall be no blemish in it.
text_cn: 如有人为还愿，或出于自愿，给上主奉献牛羊作和平祭品，应是无瑕的，方蒙悦纳；身上不应有任何残疾。

text_en: Anything blind, or injured, or maimed, or having a discharge or an itch or scabs—these you shall not offer to the Lord or put any of them on the altar as offerings by fire to the Lord .
text_cn: 眼瞎的或残废的，或断肢的，或患溃疡的，或生麻疹的，或长癣疥的：这样的牲畜，你们不可献给上主；任何这样的牲畜，不可放在祭坛上，献给上主作火祭。

text_en: An ox or a lamb that has a limb too long or too short you may present for a freewill offering; but it will not be accepted for a vow.
text_cn: 一腿太长或太短的牛或羊，你可献为自愿祭祭品；但为还愿，必不蒙悦纳。

text_en: Any animal that has its testicles bruised or crushed or torn or cut, you shall not offer to the Lord ; such you shall not do within your land,
text_cn: 此外，凡睾丸伤坏，砸碎，破裂，割去的牲畜，你们不可献给上主；在你们的地域内，万不可举行这样的祭献，

text_en: nor shall you accept any such animals from a foreigner to offer as food to your God; since they are mutilated, with a blemish in them, they shall not be accepted in your behalf.
text_cn: 也不可由外邦人手内接受这样的牲畜，献给你们的天主作供物，因为身上残废的，有缺陷的，为你们不会获得悦纳。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: When an ox or a sheep or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother, and from the eighth day on it shall be acceptable as the Lord ’s offering by fire.
text_cn: “几时牛或绵羊或山羊一生下，应七天同其母在一起；自第八天，作为上主的火祭祭品，方蒙悦纳。

text_en: But you shall not slaughter, from the herd or the flock, an animal with its young on the same day.
text_cn: 牛羊及其幼雏，不可在同一日内宰杀。

text_en: When you sacrifice a thanksgiving offering to the Lord , you shall sacrifice it so that it may be acceptable in your behalf.
text_cn: 几时你们给上主奉献感恩祭，应这样奉献，才获得悦纳：

text_en: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall not leave any of it until morning: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 祭肉，应在当天吃完，不应留到次日早晨：我是上主。

text_en: Thus you shall keep my commandments and observe them: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 你们应遵守我的命令，一一依照执行：我是上主。

text_en: You shall not profane my holy name, that I may be sanctified among the people of Israel: I am the Lord ; I sanctify you,
text_cn: 不要亵渎我的圣名，叫我在以色列子民中常被尊为圣；我是使你们成圣的上主，

text_en: I who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 是我由埃及地领你们出来，为作你们的天主：我是上主。”
